Subject: Audio recording of the Analyst call on financial results for the three months ended 
June 30, 2026 
 
 
Pursuant to Regulations 30 and 46(2) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure

recording of the Company’s Analyst Call on the financial results for the three months ended
